aioa.midnightconfig.title: AIOA Configuration
aioa.midnightconfig.hostile_spawn_settin: Only actual hostile mobs are suppressed by default. Lists now accept raw ids, friendly mob names, or labels like Zombie (minecraft:zombie).
aioa.midnightconfig.hostile_nullificatio: Apply hostile nullification in the Overworld only
aioa.midnightconfig.ignore_special_spawn: Ignore special or scripted hostile spawns
aioa.midnightconfig.day_spawn_settings_c: Configured mobs in the AIOA day pool can spawn on the surface during the day. Spawn entries accept friendly mob names or ids in the first segment, then ;enabled=true;rarity=common;chance=1.0;min=1;max=3.
aioa.midnightconfig.day_spawns_overworld: Apply day surface spawns in the Overworld only
aioa.midnightconfig.prevent_sunlight_bur: Prevent sunlight burn for configured apocalypse mobs
aioa.midnightconfig.remove_baby_variants: Remove baby variants in AIOA day spawns
aioa.midnightconfig.mob_behavior_setting: Choose which mobs use apocalypse-style AI. The global target mode applies to zombies and any mob you add to the refined AI list, while the override lists let you assign a specific target rule per entity id.
aioa.midnightconfig.refined_pathfinding_: Allow refined pathfinding to use doors
aioa.midnightconfig.coordinated_horde_ai: Share targets with nearby apocalypse mobs
aioa.config.screen.title: AIOA Configuration
aioa.config.option.hostile.enabled.desc: Cancel hostile natural-style spawns unless they are explicitly allow-listed.
aioa.config.option.hostile.overworld_onl: Leave the Nether, End, and any other dimensions alone.
aioa.config.option.hostile.ignore_struct: Do not suppress hostiles spawned by structure rules when this is enabled.
aioa.config.option.hostile.ignore_spawne: Leave mob spawners and similar block-driven spawn sources untouched.
aioa.config.option.hostile.ignore_specia: Skip patrols, events, reinforcements, spawn eggs, commands, and similar special cases.
aioa.config.option.hostile.whitelist_ent: Each entry can be a registry id, a friendly mob name, or a label like Zombie (minecraft:zombie).
aioa.config.option.day.enabled.desc: Allow configured apocalypse mobs to spawn on the surface during the day.
aioa.config.option.day.overworld_only.de: Restrict the day spawn system to the Overworld by default.
aioa.config.option.day.require_daytime.d: Only run the apocalypse surface spawner while the world is in daytime.
aioa.config.option.day.require_clear_sky: Only place day-spawn mobs in spots with direct sky access.
aioa.config.option.day.prevent_sunlight_: Protect all enabled day-pool entities from daylight burning, including naturally spawned ones.
aioa.config.option.day.remove_baby_varia: Force AIOA day-spawned baby-capable mobs to adult variants. If a mob cannot be forced to adult, that spawn is skipped.
aioa.config.option.day.export_mob_catalo: Write aioa-mob-catalog.txt in the config folder with all valid configurable mob IDs and ready-to-copy templates.
aioa.config.option.day.spawn_interval_ti: How often the day-surface spawner runs. 200 ticks is 10 seconds.
aioa.config.option.day.spawn_attempts_pe: How many weighted spawn attempts AIOA makes around each valid player per cycle.
aioa.config.option.day.min_spawn_distanc: Prevent AIOA from dropping mobs too close to players.
aioa.config.option.day.max_spawn_distanc: Set the outer ring radius for day-spawn attempts around players.
aioa.config.option.day.max_nearby_manage: Cap the number of AIOA-managed day spawns near each player.
aioa.config.option.day.allowed_biome_ids: Leave this empty to allow all biomes. Biomes still use exact registry names such as minecraft:plains.
aioa.config.option.day.spawn_pool_entrie: Format: mob_selector;enabled=true;rarity=common;chance=1.0;min=1;max=3. The first segment can be an id, friendly mob name, or Name (modid:id).
aioa.config.option.ai.zombie_variant_mod: Choose whether AIOA day-spawned zombies can appear as regular, baby, or both variants.
aioa.config.option.ai.zombie_target_mode: This default target rule applies to zombies and any mob you place into the refined AI list unless a per-entity override says otherwise.
aioa.config.option.ai.zombies_can_climb_: Lets selected apocalypse mobs scale walls like spiders when chasing something above them.
Improves pursuit with more aggressive chasing, better path refreshes, and longer awareness for selected mobs.
aioa.config.option.ai.refined_pathfindin: Allow refined pathfinding to use doors
Lets refined ground mobs path through doors instead of stalling outside structures.
aioa.config.option.ai.refined_ai_entity_: Add any vanilla or modded mob here by id or friendly name to give it the refined apocalypse chase/pathfinding behavior.
aioa.config.option.ai.wall_climbing_enti: Any mob in this list can climb like a spider while actively chasing a target. Friendly names work here too.
aioa.config.option.ai.player_only_target: Mobs in this list ignore the default target mode and focus only on players. Use ids or friendly mob names.
aioa.config.option.ai.animal_target_enti: Mobs in this list hunt animals instead of using the default apocalypse target mode. Use ids or friendly mob names.
aioa.config.option.ai.other_mob_target_e: Mobs in this list target non-player mobs for chaos-heavy scenarios. Use ids or friendly mob names.
aioa.config.option.ai.everything_target_: Mobs in this list attack nearly anything alive except themselves and other zombies. Use ids or friendly mob names.
